pattern_explanation: Each Ukrainian word looks similar to an English word, but the two words developed from different roots and drifted apart in meaning, so the look-alike English word misleads the learner.
false_friend_warning: Watch out: the Ukrainian word 'mahazyn' looks like English 'magazine', but it means 'shop', while 'magazine' means a periodical. Also, 'sympatychnyi' looks like 'sympathetic', but it means 'nice-looking', not 'showing sympathy'.
